question: Dog-Spirit, why did you help the old man?

lines: This is a page from a class seven English book.
Watch what happens when a phone looks at it.
This is Living Textbook.
A printed page cannot move, or answer a question. With Google AI, now it can.

scenes.label: 1  A science page becomes a lesson
lines: Here is a science page about a pendulum.
Gemini reads every word, number and picture, plans a lesson, and checks every number against the page.

scenes.label: On the real page
lines: On a phone, the drawing moves on the paper itself.

scenes.label: 2  A tutor you can interrupt
lines: A Gemini Live tutor explains each step.
Stop it any time, and ask.

scenes.label: 3  What if?
lines: Change a number, and the page changes too.

scenes.label: 4  A story page becomes a film
lines: Stories come alive too, with a voice for every character.
At the turning point, you choose what happens.

scenes.label: 5  Talk to the characters
lines: Then talk to the characters. They answer in their own voice.

scenes.label: 6  Made and checked by Google AI
lines: Every film is made by Google AI.
Gemini plans it, Nano Banana draws it in the book's own style, Gemini Omni films it, and Gemini gives every character a voice.
Then Gemini watches the film like a critic, and sends weak shots back to be made again.

scenes.label: 7  The same film for everyone
lines: Every page is remembered.
The next student who scans it, or any other page of the story, gets the same film in seconds.

scenes.label: 8  For classrooms and other apps
lines: Students get quizzes and progress. Teachers get chapter films for the class.
Other learning apps can add it all with one line of code.
Living Textbook. Any page, alive.
Built with Gemini on Google Cloud.
